events.body:
## Context

Security-sweep leftover, and it fixes a live bug. `package.json` has `@actions/github ^4.0.0`; `undici` 5.28.3 comes in through `@actions/core` and has open advisories. In github v4 the octokit object has no `.rest` namespace, yet `src/index.js` makes 21 `octokit.rest.*` calls (e.g. L165, L218, L320), so `handleClosedPR`, `handleOpenedPR` and `enforceClosedPRGracePeriod` throw a TypeError. The outer catch only logs, so runs still show green. This is the GitHub Action in `src/`, not the forge `/assign` code in `forge/`.

## What to do

1. Bump to `@actions/github@^8` and `@actions/core@^1.11` (8.x is the last CommonJS major; 9.x needs an ESM conversion, optional).
2. Make every call use `octokit.rest.*` consistently.
3. Move `axios` from devDependencies to dependencies (it is `require`d at runtime in `src/index.js:3`).
4. Call `core.setFailed` in the outer catch.
5. Run `npm run build` and commit the regenerated `dist/index.js` (ncc bundle; `action.yml` runs `dist/index.js`).
6. Fix `TESTING.md:112-120`, which refers to workflows that don't exist.

> **Note:** Don't touch `forge/assign.mjs` or the `/assign` workflow; that work just landed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `npm ls undici` no longer shows 5.28.3
- [ ] No `octokit.issues.` / `octokit.pulls.` calls without `.rest`
- [ ] `dist/` rebuilt from current `src/`
- [ ] A test covers `handleClosedPR` with a real `getOctokit` and nock
- [ ] `npm test` passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-action
cd blt-action && npm run build && git diff --stat dist/
```

---
